subject.title: Feature: notify sender on WhatsApp after pairing approval

question: Should the replacement fix be limited to the existing `--notify` path, or should approval notify by default and/or replay the blocked message?
rationale: The narrow source gap is clear, but the issue text proposes broader default/config/replay behavior and prior PRs exposed an SDK-shape choice.

options.title: Limit to existing `--notify`
options.body: Implement WhatsApp delivery for the documented opt-in notification path and leave default notification and replay out of scope.

options.title: Make notification default
options.body: Require a product decision, docs, and upgrade behavior for automatically messaging approved senders after every approval.

options.title: Include original-message replay
options.body: Treat replay as a broader channel/session behavior change with separate delivery and privacy review.

recommendation.title: Limit to existing `--notify`
recommendation.body: Implement WhatsApp delivery for the documented opt-in notification path and leave default notification and replay out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches plugin SDK and outbound delivery contract shape where recent history points to this owner.
